To use your Joseph Joseph product correctly and get the best results:

Follow the specific care and usage instructions supplied with your product.
Use each item only for its intended purpose (e.g., measuring tools just for measuring, bowls not for long-term storage unless stated).
Avoid direct heat, sharp metal utensils on plastic/non-stick, and abrasive cleaners unless instructions say otherwise.
Hand wash knives, wooden/bamboo boards, and scissors unless marked dishwasher-safe, and dry thoroughly.
Monitor condition regularly and replace products if they become cracked, chipped, warped, unstable, have peeling coatings, loose components, mould, persistent odors, corrosion, or if markings/blades no longer function as intended.
For wooden/bamboo boards, apply food-safe mineral oil periodically.
